THE DIRECTIONS

You will talk to four people. Record what you would say to each one. You can record again as many times as you want. When all four are recorded, click Submit.

The first time you press record, your computer will ask to use your microphone. Click Allow.

THE SCENE

You built the world map for the class story. You are alone at the map table and four boxes are empty. You need four moments to fill them. Four people each know one.

THE HISTORY

Your world comes from a story about an agreement. In 1613 the Haudenosaunee and the Dutch made an agreement. They marked it on a wampum belt of shell beads. Two purple rows mean two groups on two paths.
